card.name: Calcium channel blocker text, before dose or name
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas, brackets and linking words in verapamil or calcium channel blocker labels, just before a dose number or a calcium channel gene or drug name. Also the opening bracket before the CACNA gene name.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: The blank space just before a milligram number in verapamil dosing text.

modes.label: Bracket before CACNA gene
modes.description: The opening bracket or first letter before the calcium channel receptor gene name in malignant hyperthermia warnings.
modes.example: inherited ryanodine receptor<< (>> RYR1 ) or dihy

modes.label: Link before calcium blocker names
modes.description: A comma, "and" or "of" in lists of calcium channel blockers just before the next drug name.
modes.example: Calcium Channel Blockers : amlodipine, diltiazem, felodipine<<,>> nicardipine, nifed
